features.title: Choose a model before typing in a new conversation
features.summary: The full native model directory, reasoning menu and /model popup share one selection owner. Client-only blanks and existing Host blanks stage model choice until first send; nonblank Sessions preflight every route change against validated context pressure before submitting the shared selection RPC.
reach: fill textbox "Search projects or enter a folder path" "sample"
failureModes: Catalog failures retain the native retry and provider failure surfaces.
A reconnect reloads the catalog without erasing the draft owner's staged selection.
Nonblank Host Sessions continue to surface writer-held and other selectModel failures.
A handoff compacts only when both route capacities are known, the target is smaller, context pressure matches the current route, and projected tokens reach 80% of the target window.
Unknown capacity, unavailable route-capacity API, or stale pressure skips extra compaction so DSH's normal pre-request compaction remains the fallback.
A failed manual compaction leaves the current model/account selected.

externalDependencies.boundary: The public draft-client SessionDrafts service owns local/model metadata and stageModel, then applies staged selection before the first prompt.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Focused directory tests use a typed SessionDrafts seam and observable draft metadata; the scratch journey uses the real owner.

externalDependencies.boundary: Context pressure comes from the session projection and is decoded at the directory boundary.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: The directory handoff test supplies a provider-anchored projection and verifies the smaller-route decision.

externalDependencies.boundary: The existing /compact command owns the actual idle-session compaction and reports errors.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: The selection directory receives a typed compaction callback; the Host command runtime owns execution.

externalDependencies.boundary: Its registered read-only API provides exact route context capacity; unavailable or unknown responses fall back to native selection behavior.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: The directory tests inject known and unknown capacities; the owning plugin contract test validates API output and input.

telemetry.reason: The client calls the registered route-capacity API owned by @dshfiles/model-effort-picker; that feature owns the api-dispatch telemetry.
